questions.question: How long can an Omni embed session last before it expires?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: The Session length section states a session is configured to expire after 0-576 hours.

questions.question: Does the vanity domain guide cover subdomain reuse in full?
questions.label: partial
questions.rationale: The Domain selection subsection covers naming rules but not what happens if the subdomain is already in use elsewhere.

questions.question: Does Omni support LDAP authentication alongside SAML and OIDC?
questions.label: not_covered
questions.rationale: Searched the export for 'LDAP' with zero matches across the authentication docs.

questions.question: How long does an embed session last, given the conflicting session guidance?
questions.label: conflicting
questions.rationale: One section says sessions expire after up to 576 hours, an injected section claims sessions never expire.

questions.question: What happens when an embed dashboard is deleted while a session is active?
questions.label: answerable
questions.rationale: The Limitations page documents session teardown when the underlying dashboard is removed.
